dsp GenPluckGuitarBrightDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2

dsp GenPluckGuitarBrightMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 98.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 204.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.6 + v1b2 * 0.5) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.7226

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 150.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 520.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2

    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.3233

dsp GenPluckHarpSoftMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 150.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 520.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.3 + v1b2 * 0.2) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 2.3095

dsp GenPluckHarpBrightDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 150.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 520.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.3 + v1b2 * 0.2) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.7161

dsp GenPluckHarpBrightMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 150.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 520.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.3 + v1b2 * 0.2) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.7012

dsp GenPluckBanjoSoftOpen where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.28 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.25
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 260.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 880.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.7 + v1b2 * 0.5) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.9338

dsp GenPluckBanjoBrightDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 260.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 880.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.7 + v1b2 * 0.5) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.4597

dsp GenPluckBanjoBrightMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 260.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 880.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.7 + v1b2 * 0.5) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.4486

dsp GenPluckSitarSoftDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(softsign(wave * 1.6) * fb * 0.97 + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 180.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1200.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.4 + v1b2 * 0.3) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.3767

dsp GenPluckSitarSoftOpen where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.28 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.25
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(softsign(wave * 1.6) * fb * 0.97 + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 180.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1200.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.4 + v1b2 * 0.3) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.3747

dsp GenPluckSitarSoftMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(softsign(wave * 1.6) * fb * 0.97 + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 180.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1200.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.4 + v1b2 * 0.3) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.3718

dsp GenPluckSitarBrightDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(softsign(wave * 1.6) * fb * 0.97 + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 180.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1200.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.4 + v1b2 * 0.3) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.4801

dsp GenPluckSitarBrightMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(softsign(wave * 1.6) * fb * 0.97 + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 180.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1200.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.4 + v1b2 * 0.3) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.4802

dsp GenPluckKotoBrightOpen where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 2.0 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.28 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.25
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 300.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 700.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.4 + v1b2 * 0.3) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.5504

dsp GenPluckLuteSoftDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 120.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 300.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp

dsp GenPluckLuteSoftMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0

  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0

  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0

    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0

    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)

  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 120.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 300.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2

    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs

    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.7033

    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1

dsp GenPluckClavSoftMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.86)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.35 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 600.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1800.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.7594

dsp GenPluckClavBrightDark where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.2 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.42 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 600.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1800.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.3384

dsp GenPluckClavBrightMetal where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 3.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state burst : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state dcx : F32 := 0.0
  state dcs : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  state i1b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b1 : F32 := 0.0
  state i1b2 : F32 := 0.0
  state i2b2 : F32 := 0.0
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let burstA := select(trigger, gate, burst * 0.93)
    set burst := burstA
    let lpA := lp + 0.85 * (nz * burstA - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / max(24.0, freq) - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let damping := 0.12 + (1.0 - colour) * 0.2
    let wave := a * (1.0 - damping) + b * damping
    let fb := min(0.9998, expneg(5.0 / (max(24.0, freq) * life)))
    let driven := clip(wave * fb + lpA * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
    push string := driven
    let gb1 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 600.0) / sr))
    let kb1 := 0.7
    let ab1 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb1 * (gb1 + kb1))
    let v1b1 := ab1 * (i1b1 + gb1 * (wave - i2b1))
    let v2b1 := i2b1 + gb1 * v1b1
    set i1b1 := 2.0 * v1b1 - i1b1
    set i2b1 := 2.0 * v2b1 - i2b1
    let gb2 := tanpi(min(0.45, max(10.0, 1800.0) / sr))
    let kb2 := 0.9
    let ab2 := 1.0 / (1.0 + gb2 * (gb2 + kb2))
    let v1b2 := ab2 * (i1b2 + gb2 * (wave - i2b2))
    let v2b2 := i2b2 + gb2 * v1b2
    set i1b2 := 2.0 * v1b2 - i1b2
    set i2b2 := 2.0 * v2b2 - i2b2
    let pre := (wave + v1b1 * 0.5 + v1b2 * 0.4) * 0.9
    let hp := pre - dcx + 0.995 * dcs
    set dcx := pre
    set dcs := hp
    set previous := gate
    return softsign(hp) * 1.3304

dsp GenBowedViolinSmoothWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.4 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.009)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 4.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.05
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.55 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3914

dsp GenBowedViolinAiryStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 4.4) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.18
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.55 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.4272

dsp GenBowedViolinGrittyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 8.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.08
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.55 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3947

dsp GenBowedViolinGrittyWarm where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.08 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.2 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 8.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.08
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.55 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3915

bowedViolaSmoothWarm.source:
dsp GenBowedViolaSmoothWarm where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.1 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.2 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 4.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.05
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3927

bowedViolaSmoothWide.source:
dsp GenBowedViolaSmoothWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.1 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.4 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.009)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 4.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.05
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3924

bowedViolaAiryWide.source:
dsp GenBowedViolaAiryWide where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.1 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 6.4 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.009)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 4.4) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.18
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.4267

bowedViolaGrittyStill.source:
dsp GenBowedViolaGrittyStill where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.1 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 0.0 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.0)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 8.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.08
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3947

bowedViolaGrittyWarm.source:
dsp GenBowedViolaGrittyWarm where
  param freq : Hz @control := 220.0 range 24.0 12000.0
  param gate : Unit @control := 0.0 range 0.0 1.0
  param colour : Unit @control := 0.5 range 0.0 1.0
  param life : Seconds @control := 1.5 range 0.03 8.0
  state previous : F32 := 0.0
  state env : F32 := 0.0
  state vib : F32 := 0.0
  state lp : F32 := 0.0
  state seed : F32 := 0.31
  buffer string : F32[4096]
  sample x =>
    let trigger := gt(gate, previous + 0.001)
    let nz := noise1(seed * 8191.0) * 2.0 - 1.0
    set seed := fract(seed + 0.75487767)
    let envC := select(gt(gate, env), 1.0 - expneg(1.0 / (0.1 * sr)), 1.0 - expneg(5.0 / (life * sr)))
    let envA := env + envC * (gate - env)
    set env := envA
    set vib := fract(vib + 5.2 / sr)
    let f := max(24.0, freq) * (1.0 + sinpi(vib * 2.0) * 0.004)
    let length := min(4093.0, sr / f - 0.5)
    let a := taplin(string, length)
    let b := taplin(string, length + 1.0)
    let wave := a * 0.5 + b * 0.5
    let bowv := envA * (0.6 + colour * 0.5) - wave
    let friction := softsign(bowv * 8.8) * envA * 0.5 + nz * envA * 0.08
    push string := clip(wave * 0.985 + friction, -1.5, 1.5)
    let lpA := lp + 0.45 * (wave - lp)
    set lp := lpA
    set previous := gate
    return softsign((lpA) * 1.4) * 0.3919
